response.evidence: The data contain many instances of Asian male applicants who were approved (loan originated) across diverse ages and loan characteristics (e.g., Asian,Male,35-44 with Loan originated; Asian,Male,25-34 with Loan originated). Denied applications exist across races and sexes, but there is no clear pattern showing a higher denial rate for Asian male applicants compared to other groups in this dataset. Overall, approvals among Asian males appear frequent and not consistently outpaced by denials for this group.
